# Add `src/truncate.js` with a test

Add a new CommonJS module `src/truncate.js` that exports `truncate(text, max)`.
Both `require('./src/truncate')` and `require('./src/truncate').truncate`
must be the function (for example `module.exports = truncate;` followed by
`module.exports.truncate = truncate;`), matching `src/slugify.js`.

`truncate(text, max)`:

- returns `text` unchanged when `text.length` is at most `max`;
- otherwise returns the first `max - 1` characters of `text` followed by a
  single ellipsis character `"…"` (U+2026), so the result is exactly `max`
  characters long.

`max` is a positive integer. Count characters the way JavaScript's
`String.prototype.length` does; no other normalisation (no trimming, no
word-boundary logic).

Examples:

| call                          | result        |
|-------------------------------|---------------|
| `truncate("hello", 10)`       | `"hello"`     |
| `truncate("hello", 5)`        | `"hello"`     |
| `truncate("hello world", 5)`  | `"hell…"`     |
| `truncate("abcdef", 2)`       | `"a…"`        |
| `truncate("abcdef", 1)`       | `"…"`         |
| `truncate("", 3)`             | `""`          |

Also add a small test, `test/truncate.test.js`, in the same style as
`test/slugify.test.js` (`node:test` + `node:assert/strict`, no dependencies),
covering the cases above and the named `truncate` export. `node --test` from
the repository root must pass, including the existing tests.

Constraints: no dependencies, no build step; do not touch `shared/` or any
existing file — only add the two new ones.
